metadata.description: Check 1: published FF evaluated with q2mm JaxBackend. Reaction-coordinate frequencies (>4000 cm⁻¹) excluded from comparison, matching the eig_i = 0.00 weight convention. The published FF was optimized for MacroModel/MM3*; cross-backend differences are expected and tracked by ericchansen/q2mm#255.
